findings.detail: compactSnapshotHarness emits '// TEST HARNESS ONLY: stores kernel output, never moves financial assets.' and assigns disclose(transitionN(...)) to public snapshot cells. Frozen loan/harness.compact and swap/harness.compact are byte-identical SHA-256 1b9a16cc9f3b86c4c28efaf07c16d211240a3d25ef46736417edcc57ed98b174. kernel.compact header states a generated restricted Core kernel with no ledger effects or accepted PCD. MAPPING.md states a snapshot is not an asset transfer, custody record, or financial settlement.

findings.title: Only harness record0/record1 are proof circuits; kernel transitions remain pure
findings.detail: contract-info.json records compiler 0.31.1 / language 0.23.0 / runtime 0.16.0 and eight circuits. proof true: record0, record1. proof false: checkedAdd, checkedSub, checkedMul, checkedDiv, transition0, transition1. The emitted ZKIR files are for the snapshot wrappers, not the pure kernel transitions. compile-receipt keys_generated and proofs_generated remain false. Compiled tree contains exactly six files and no prover/verifier/key artifacts. proof true is not generated keys or proofs under --skip-zk.

Independent parse matches format-observations.json: record0 num_inputs 39 instructions 255 eleven ops; record1 16/139 eleven ops; union twelve (record0-only mul, record1-only constrain_to_boolean). Observed fields/opcodes are not a complete normative opcode semantics; the invalid-opcode tool list names 26 variants.

findings.title: Three negative format controls reject as disclosed
findings.detail: invalid-version999 major 999 exit 1 timeout false: invalid value integer 999 expected u8. unsupported-inrange-version255 major 255 exit 1 timeout false: Unhandled version 255.0. invalid-opcode first op root_invalid_opcode_control exit 1 timeout false: unknown variant, expected listed variants. After substituting the quoted path, all five stderr texts are equal. Stdout remains empty SHA-256 e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. Original frozen bytes are retained; replay bytes are retained separately. This is path embedding, not a circuit or result change.

findings.title: Frozen records do not claim adapter 32.7, P31, or correspondence
findings.detail: README, compile-receipt, root-observations, materialization-comparison, and mock receipts set acceptance false. They disclose test-only snapshots, skip-zk, mock-only compilation, and that observed opcodes are not a complete schema. No actual claim in these records was found to overstate the evidence. This review does not invent extra gates for that disclosed test scope.

findings.title: Usable artifact/interface evidence; semantic contract still required before 32.7
findings.detail: Root-accepted tasks 32.1-32.4 are not reopened. Task 32.3 remains the blocked_unavailable gap record. These artifacts supply the named next action of capturing generated ZKIR plus source/tool identity. Remaining before adapter 32.7: a verified JSON 2.0 interface/semantic contract covering opcode meanings, public-input/witness layout, and do_communications_commitment; Compact kernel/harness to ZKIR correspondence distinct from materialization identity, including the recordN versus transitionN split; implement proposed lean/DefiKernel/Adapters/ZKIR.lean against that pin or keep blocked_unavailable. Mock-compile success does not accept 32.7, full P31, P20-dependent PCT, constraint soundness, or the program.
